source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10 ("Nominations for county and rural councils: no contests for Antrim County Council")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: 'There will be no contests for membership of Antrim County Council, all the persons nominated being returned unopposed' (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10); the printed list names 21 members and the two divisions it omits are filled from the members returned in 1949 and 1955.

note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council; nominations received on 20 May 1952, withdrawals to 21 May, and polling, where necessary, on Thursday 5 June 1952 ('polling day will be Thursday, June 5', Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10). There was no contest in any Antrim division, so no poll was held in the county. No party labels were printed. Added from reports of the new council's meetings early in the term, each division inferred from the previous return: Glenarm. Returned unopposed.
